purpose: Teach: 養育/全滅/大佐/私学/プロパガンダ/痴漢/偽善/処方箋

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、養育放棄事案を警察、慎重に扱われてますね
lines.en: The police are handling this child neglect case carefully, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly uncertain. Soft rising inflection at the end—genuinely asking, not leading. Thoughtful pause before speaking, as if processing what he's observed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査チームが全滅しないよう体制を整えております
lines.en: We're structured so the investigation team doesn't get overwhelmed.
lines.style: Direct, professional. Calm steady tone. Brief, confident—the answer of someone used to briefing. No defensiveness, just clear fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、軍OBの大佐との連携を警察、なさってますね
lines.en: And you're coordinating with a retired military colonel on this, I notice.
lines.style: Slightly hesitant, probing gently. Not accusatory—more like he's thinking aloud, testing whether he's understood correctly. Respectful distance in his voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、私学への防犯指導も担当します
lines.en: We also handle crime prevention training for private schools.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, listing responsibility. Steady tempo. The tone of someone outlining scope without overselling it. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、プロパガンダ的書き込みを警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: I see you're investigating propaganda-style posts connected to this case.
lines.style: Quieter this time, more introspective. Slight emphasis on 'propaganda'—he's recognising something troubling. Trailing off slightly, as if the implications are still settling.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、痴漢事件は厳しく対応します
lines.en: We take groping incidents very seriously.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Conviction underneath. The words are simple but carried with weight—this is non-negotiable. Eye-level, unflinching.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、偽善的な寄付詐欺を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: So you're also investigating donation fraud that's hiding behind goodwill.
lines.style: Quiet disappointment colouring his voice. Slow, deliberate. He's articulating something he finds troubling. Not angry—more like sad recognition of something deliberately deceptive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不正な処方箋発行事件にも対応します
lines.en: And we're responding to illegal prescription issuing as well.
lines.style: Slightly quieter than before, less formal. Still professional but with a note of weariness—another layer to what's already being handled. Steady, almost resigned competence.
